snippet.title: Last Stand | Launch Trailer | Meta Quest Platform
snippet.description:
Last Stand is the world's first multi-location mixed reality PVP shootout, transforming players’ home spaces into strongholds where room layouts & full-body movement become a tactical advantage. 

Buy now on the Meta Quest store: https://metaque.st/3B4zGR5
